signals.name: Lambda, commanded
signals.description: The ratio of oxygen in the combustion chamber compared to the amount that should have been present for ideal combustion.

Exhaust differential pressure
signals.description: This sensor is crucial for monitoring how clogged the DPF has become. It measures the pressure before and after the DPF in the exhaust system, with the difference between these two measurements indicating how restricted the filter has become. When the pressure difference becomes too high (indicating a clogged filter), the ECM will initiate a regeneration process to burn off the accumulated soot and clean the filter.

signals.name: Variable geometry turbocharger open
signals.description: Measures the position of the vanes in the Variable Geometry Turbocharger (VGT) and reports this position as a percentage value.

signals.name: Oil dilution events
signals.description: Monitors fuel dilution in your engine oil, which is when fuel (gasoline) mixes with the engine oil in the crankcase.
